function.description: Returns the count of network device image updates based on the given filter criteria
function.name: api_countOfNetworkDeviceImageUpdates

endTime.description: Image update started before the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

hostName.description: Host name of the network device for the image update. Supports case-insensitive partial search.

id.description: Update id which is unique for each network device under the parentId

imageName.description: Software image name for the update

managementAddress.description: Management address of the network device

parentId.description: Updates that have this parent id

startTime.description: Image update started after the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

status.description: Status of the image update. Available values: FAILURE, SUCCESS, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING

count.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
